Do you want to work with the latest machines and innovative technologies for eye care that are used worldwide? Apply now! As a production operator, you work with modern and precise machines used to make lenses. Together with your team, you ensure that everything runs smoothly and that the quality is always top-notch. You spend a lot of time setting up and operating the machines, checking the products, and carefully applying chemicals to the lenses. The job requires precision and the ability to switch quickly. You ensure that production continues to run and that each pair of glasses meets the high quality standards.

To excel in this role, you are driven to achieve the highest possible results and adapt effortlessly to changing circumstances. You communicate clearly and openly, making you a valuable collaborative partner within the team. Furthermore, you possess:  - A VMBO/MBO education
 - You speak either English or Dutch
 - You have an eye for detail

Imagine starting your day in a buzzing warehouse where no two days are ever the same. As a Warehouse Operative, you’ll become part of an enthusiastic and supportive team that keeps everything running smoothly behind the scenes. From the moment products arrive until they’re on their way to customers, you’ll play a key role in making it all happen.

You’ll move between different departments. Sometimes you’re receiving goods in inbound, other times you’re carefully picking and packing orders that need to go out the door. Every task you handle contributes to a seamless process, ensuring customers get exactly what they need, right on time.

Along the way, you’ll also get hands-on experience with equipment like forklifts, reach trucks, and OPT systems. Never used them before? That’s no problem, comprehensive training is provided so you can quickly gain confidence and expand your skills.

Teamwork is at the heart of this role. You’ll collaborate closely with your colleagues, supporting each other to hit daily targets and celebrating successes together. Accuracy and attention to detail are key, because every order counts and every customer matters.

This is more than just a warehouse role. It’s a chance to grow, learn, and become part of a dynamic environment where your contribution truly makes a difference.

Proficiency in English or Dutch is required.

- Good salary depending on your experience
- Direct contract with the employer
- Supportive working environment: training provided so you can develop your skills
- Dynamic and varied role: no two days are the same
- Career opportunities: chance to grow further in warehousing and logistics

jobs.description:
Start your technical career in the Netherlands Are you an experienced Maintenance Technician based in Portugal and ready for an international step in your career? Xelvin is looking for motivated technical professionals who want to relocate to the Netherlands and work in industrial maintenance, production technology or technical service environments. In this role, you will work as part of a technical department and help keep machines, production lines and installations running smoothly. You will solve technical issues, carry out preventive maintenance and contribute to a safe, reliable and efficient production process. This position is suitable for technicians with experience in industrial maintenance, mechanics, electromechanics, automation or technical service. What you will do As a Maintenance Technician, you are responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving technical installations and production equipment. You will work in a practical, hands-on environment where no two days are the same. Your responsibilities may include: Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on machines, production lines and technical installations. Diagnosing mechanical, electrical, pneumatic or hydraulic faults. Repairing and replacing machine parts, sensors, motors, pumps, conveyors or other technical components. Supporting production teams when technical problems occur. Carrying out inspections and basic testing of equipment. Reading and using technical drawings, electrical diagrams or machine documentation. Registering maintenance activities and technical findings. Thinking along about improvements in reliability, safety and efficiency. Working according to safety standards and company procedures. Cooperating with colleagues from production, engineering and technical service. Depending on your experience, the role can be more mechanically, electrically or electromechanically focused. What Xelvin offers you Relocating to another country is a big step. Xelvin supports you

throughout the process, from the first interview to your first working day in the Netherlands. We offer: A full-time job with long-term perspective in the Netherlands. A competitive gross monthly salary between €2,800 and €4,200, depending on your experience, technical background and the type of company. Possible shift allowance, depending on the working schedule and production environment. 25 paid holidays, in addition to Dutch public holidays. 8.33% holiday allowance. Pension arrangement. Support during onboarding and your first period in the Netherlands. Personal guidance from Xelvin. Opportunities for training, courses and career development. Job description Are you an ambitious Instrumentation Technician (E&I) from South Africa who is ready to build an international career in the Netherlands? Xelvin is looking for talented technicians who want to work in one of Europe's leading petrochemical environments. As an Instrumentation Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, calibrating and troubleshooting instrumentation and electrical systems that are essential for safe and reliable plant operations. You will join a highly skilled maintenance team where safety, quality and continuous improvement are key priorities. This position is based in Geleen, one of the largest industrial and petrochemical hubs in the Netherlands. Your responsibilities Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on instrumentation and electrical systems. Calibrate pressure, temperature, flow and level transmitters. Troubleshoot electrical and instrumentation faults. Install and commission new field instrumentation. Read and interpret P&IDs, loop drawings and electrical schematics. Assist during plant shutdowns and turnarounds. Ensure all work complies with safety regulations and quality standards. Contribute to improving plant reliability and equipment performance. Employment conditions At Xelvin, we do much more than help you find a job. We help you build a future in the Netherlands. You can expect: A salary between €3,800 and €4,700 gross per month Full-time employment with long-term career opportunities Overtime and shift allowances where applicable 25 vacation days plus holiday allowance Pension scheme Extensive training and development opportunities Personal guidance throughout your career Complete relocation support Moving to another country is a big step. That's why Xelvin supports you throughout the entire relocation process. Our relocation package includes: Work visa and residence permit support Assistance with finding suitable accommodation Flight to the Netherlands Airport pick-up Municipal registration (BSN)

Opening a Dutch bank account Health insurance guidance Dutch language lessons Ongoing support from your dedicated Xelvin Consultant Job requirements We are looking for motivated professionals who are ready to take the next step in their international career. You have: A recognised trade qualification in Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I), Instrumentation or Electrical Engineering. Experience as an Instrumentation Technician or E&I Technician. Experience within the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical or Chemical industry. Knowledge of process instrumentation, control valves and field devices. Experience reading P&IDs and electrical drawings. Good English communication skills. Afrikaans language skills (preferred). A proactive attitude and willingness to relocate to the Netherlands. Preferably between 23 and 28 years old, making this an excellent opportunity for early-career professionals looking to build an international career. About the organisation Xelvin has over 20 years of experience in connecting technical professionals with leading companies throughout the Netherlands. Every year we help engineers and technicians from South Africa relocate successfully to the Netherlands, where they build long-term careers with international employers. Xelvin provides comprehensive relocation assistance, from immigration support to housing and settling into Dutch life. Our client operates in one of Europe's largest petrochemical clusters and is committed to innovation, safety and sustainability. You will work with modern technologies in an international environment where technical expertise is highly valued.
